description: Convert between present and future value (time value of money). With direction "future" the amount is a present value grown to its future value at the given annual rate; with direction "present" it is a future value discounted back to present value. Compounds compoundsPerYear times per year (1 = annually).

amount.description: The known value: a present value when direction is "future", or a future value when direction is "present"

annualRatePercent.description: Annual interest / discount rate as a percent, e.g. 5

direction.description: Whether to grow the amount to a future value or discount it to a present value

years.description: Number of years, may be fractional

name: calculate_time_value
